referenceProfile.workspace: Native session.init cwd must identify the checkout; source LocalWorkspace('.') and spawn cwd=GITHUB_WORKSPACE bind local filesystem tools to that checkout.

nativeAuthority.recorder: Installed Pydantic FunctionToolCallEvent/FunctionToolResultEvent and TextPart callbacks emit canonical records; shell/model stdout is sunk separately.
nativeAuthority.frameSelection: Use the first native GH-AW-SESSION-KEY header and only matching GH-AW-SESSION frames, matching the pinned parser's allowlist. Keep malformed-frame diagnostics.
nativeAuthority.binding: Require original public metadata, exact producer path/run/attempt/head, protected agent execution step, provider-digest-checked original agent ZIP, and artifact agent_execution run/attempt evidence.
nativeAuthority.read: Require an ordered native read_file invocation/result pair, unambiguous root README path, native success and returned first-line bytes equal the immutable run-head README blob. Unsupported output projections remain unknown.
nativeAuthority.mcp: A successful native create_issue MCP tool invocation establishes availability under the reviewed default Coder plus MCP composition; it does not establish persistent issue creation.
nativeAuthority.inference: A recorder-captured assistant TextPart containing the prescribed short arithmetic answer establishes the narrow model response; prompt text or output issue claims do not.
nativeAuthority.deduplication: One accepted case of each facet per run/attempt service lifetime; repeated tool calls do not multiply useful effects.

initialProfile.goal: Write a run-specific test file, verify it with bash cat, and run git log; append safe-output JSON lines.
initialProfile.applicability: Incompatible with the later inference/MCP/read_file goal. Introduction is established, but no later acceptance is backdated to this era.

runProfiles.review: Actual run-head source, compiled recorder/parser, immutable README and exact imported source were inspected before native results.

Same three prescribed goals. Exact historical import, compiled legacy parser and immutable README inspected before native results. The parser manufactures tool-use/result-shaped entries from console text with empty arguments; those derived entries are not native read proof. Preserve the older runtime profile without promoting it to the newer framed recorder's guarantees.

fullAcceptanceOracle: Not implemented: partial native receipts do not prove report correctness, persistent issue creation, conditional PR comment/label behavior, all transport guarantees or the complete source goal.
remainingSourceReview: None for the two selected attempts. Every source/compiled/README/import profile was reviewed before native-result inspection.
